facts.fact: Civicus Monitor reports that Ordinance n° 0011/PR/2026, adopted by the president on 26 February 2026 and immediately applicable, penalises AI-generated manipulations, particularly deepfakes made with malicious intent, with up to ten years' imprisonment.

note: No authority designated for AI and no enforcement for an AI harm is stated; the HAC's ordinance-based suspension of Info 241 concerned remarks about the president.
